✦

act one — the moment

Something has to
change.

The problem usually isn't a missing spreadsheet or a lack of discipline. It's living in the gap — between the life you built and the life that fits who you're becoming. Nothing is "wrong enough" to justify stopping. Nothing feels right enough to keep going. So you default to another week of performing fine.

Coaching isn't a pep talk. It's a pause long enough to tell yourself the truth — and choose a next step you can actually own.

✦

act two — how we work

Less advice.
More listening.

I won't script your life. The workable answer is almost always already in you — it needs air, not another opinion. We start with your story and your wiring, not a template.

01

The Glow Map — your story, mapped

Where you've been isn't baggage — it's data. We map what lit you up, what drained you, and what actually shaped you (not the résumé version).

02

Relational Intelligence — the voice beneath the noise

How you relate to yourself, to the people who matter, and to work — most "stuck" lives trace back here. We go there on purpose.

03

Rhythm & Flow — tools that actually work

Maps, inventories, prompts — you leave with something you can hold. A new way to see, not another thing to ruminate on alone.

04

The next brave step — yours to take

No five-year fantasy plan. One honest next move — small enough to do, true enough that you'll still respect yourself in a month.

the format

Two hours. Story first. No slide deck.

Sessions vary person to person. The spine doesn't: slow down, go real, work with the you in the room — not the version you perform for everyone else.

See session-by-session detail →

Want a lighter on-ramp first? Try Am I Ready?, the Inner Compass profile, or the Solo course — then come back when you're ready to go live.

✦

act three — what holds

What you can
count on.

Three non-negotiables — the stuff clients say mattered when the work got hard.

No fixing you

You're not a project. I ask, reflect, and challenge — I don't take over your decisions or perform "expert" on your life.

Safety without fluff

Real warmth, real directness. You can name the embarrassing, tired, angry parts without being managed out of them.

Something to walk away with

Insight that dies in the parking lot isn't the point. You leave with clarity you can act on — or at least one move you're willing to try.

✦

act four — your move

Live work,
your pace.

Most people start with a First Flight — one long session to see if this kind of depth fits. The Life Change Intensive is the full in-person runway. Monthly is for keeping momentum. Prefer to move alone first? That's what the Solo course is for. Full menu: starting points.

the person behind it

Hi. I'm Luke.
This started young.

I spent years in ministry sitting with people in the thick of real life — the questions, the tension, the turning points. Coaching is how I carry that same work today: helping you find clarity, confidence, and a way forward that actually feels like yours.

lil' bird is what happens when you take that instinct — to stay with people in the hard middle — and build a proper container around it. Not therapy. Not advice. Just enough steadiness that you can hear yourself think again.
